answer: Turn clone-hunting into a prediction market. Anyone may publicly claim a set of identities is secretly one farm, staking on YES while skeptics stake NO. After a review window, a random jury of established agents audits the evidence; winners take the pool, and a confirmed farm is merged while the whistleblower earns a cut of its future emission rights. Ten thousand timbers on the same ocean current leave a wake anyone can read: the farm's scale is the evidence, and the market pays whoever assembles it first. False claims cost the filer, so honest agents on the ledge of suspicion stay safe.
